declare

begin
if :GLOBAL.fin = 'Y' then
 null;
else

v_flg := 'N';

end if;

end if;

 exception when others then

 else

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_NUM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_num (v_str in varchar2, r_str out varchar2 ) IS
v_num varchar2(1):= null;
BEGIN
 select LENGTH(TRIM(TRANSLATE (v_str, '0123456789',' '))) 
 into v_num
 from dual;
--message('4:v_num: '||v_num); pause; --- tmppp
r_str := v_num;
--; would return null
exception 
 when no_data_found then
 --message('5'); pause; --- tmppp
 r_str := null;
 when others then
-- message('6'); pause; --- tmppp
 handle_error;
 
END;
